biography.value:
魔蝠Mephits

    魔蝠外形跟小魔鬼相似，是一种栖息在诸元素位面而又变化多端的生物。魔蝠共六种，每种都代表两种元素的混合。
    魔幅们是不老不死的魔术师，它们大量聚集在各元素位面和元素混沌中，有时还会找到前往物质位面的通路，并在那里寻找自己基础元素丰富之地作为自己喜好的居所。例如，由土与火合成的熔岩魔幅喜欢在火山里筑巢，而由气和水组成的冰魔幅则偏爱冰封的地带。

    元素本质Elemental Nature。魔蝠不需要饮食和睡眠。

冰魔蝠Ice Mephit

    由冷气和水组成的冰魔幅淡漠而冰冷，其冷酷残忍胜过所有其他的魔幅。

Mephits are capricious, imp-like creatures native to the elemental planes. They come in six varieties, each one representing the mixture of two elements.

Ageless tricksters, mephits gather in large numbers on the Elemental Planes and in the Elemental Chaos. They also find their way to the Material Plane, where they prefer to dwell in places where their base elements are abundant. For example, a magma mephit is composed of earth and fire, and it favors volcanic lairs, while an ice mephit, which is composed of air and water, favors frigid locales.

Elemental Nature. A mephit doesn't require food, drink, or sleep.

Ice Mephit

Comprising frigid air and water, ice mephits are aloof and cold, surpassing all other mephits in pitiless cruelty

description.value:
近战武器攻击：命中+3，触及5尺。单一生物。伤害：3（1d4+1）点挥砍伤害外加2（1d4）点冷冻伤害。

Melee Weapon Attack: [[/r 1d20+3]]{+3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 ([[/damage 1d4 + 1 type=slashing]]) damage plus 2 ([[/damage 1d4 type=cold]]) damage.

魔蝠呼出冰冷的空气覆盖前方一处15尺的锥状区域。区域内的每个生物必须成功通过一次DC 10的敏捷豁免否则将受到5（2d4）点冷冻伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。

The mephit exhales a 15-foot cone of cold air. Each creature in that area must succeed on a [[/save ability=dex dc=10]] saving throw, taking 5 ([[/damage 2d4 type=cold]]) damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

魔幅有25%的成功率召唤1d4只与自己同类的魔幅。被召唤的魔幅将出现在其召唤者60尺内的一处未被占领的空间位置中。它们将作为召唤者的盟友行动且不能召唤其他的魔幅。这些魔幅持续存在1分钟，或直至其本身或者其召唤者死亡。其召唤者也可以用一个动作将其解散。

The mephit has a [[/r 1d100]]{25 percent} chance of summoning [[/r 1d4]] mephits of its kind. A summoned mephit appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of its summoner, acts as an ally of its summoner, and can't summon other mephits. It remains for 1 minute, until it or its summoner dies, or until its summoner dismisses it as an action.

魔蝠死亡时，它的尸体会爆炸成一片锐利的碎冰，其周围5尺范围内的所有生物必须进行一次DC 10的敏捷豁免，豁免失败者将受到4（1d8）点挥砍伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半

When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of jagged ice. Each creature within 5 feet of it must make a [[/save ability=dex dc=10]] saving throw, taking 4 ([[/damage 1d8 type=slashing]]) damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

魔蝠静止不动时和普通的冰锥几乎一模一样。

While the mephit remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary shard of ice.

You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is &Reference[rule=heavilyobscured]{heavily obscured}. It lasts for the duration or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the radius of the fog increases by 20 feet for each slot level above 1st.

魔蝠天生可以施展云雾术fog cloud且无需任何材料成分。其施法属性为魅力。

Innate Spellcasting (1/Day). The mephit can innately cast @UUID[.czKs9LuKpXOD67sH], requiring no material components. Its innate spellcasting ability is Charisma.
